description: Armada PXA-610 is an application processor SoC (http://www.marvell.com/application processors/armada-600/). It has a dedicated security hardware module, known as WTM, that runs secure firmware kernel to perform device trusted boot, access control, authentication, key management, DRM, disk encryption, and FIPS certified cryptographic operations.

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
